notes.title: 《Reformers》Ver1.50
notes.content:
1. New monsters: Skeletons and Ghostfire.
2. Added Harbour Map.
3. Added space maze.
4. Added a harbor church to challenge NPCs.
5. Add a variety of equipment and props.
Fixed:
1. Mana cost of some abilities has been reduced.
Supplement:
The new map may appear a flashback phenomenon, the reason is unknown, do a good save after reopening.
The current version of the main plot has been completely ended, continue to maintain a year more, GU GU GU.
Happy 2021 New Year to all the players!!

notes.title: 《Reformers Intl Ver》Ver1.30

Details:
1. New magic objects: mouse clan, cheeper clan, dragon clan.
2. Added a map on the second floor of the grocery store to open a new side quest: fantasyland.Through the world of fantasy land can be opened [magic sword], [sewer sound], [red lotus grottoes], [wan long temple] a total of four levels, and can repeat the challenge, there is a chance to get the spirit spirit of magic objects.
